title: Is that all?
description: A bilingual lesson about buying envelopes, writing paper, glue and chalk, with practice on some/any, quantities, time expressions and short answers. 关于购买信封、信纸、胶水和粉笔的双语课程，练习 some/any、数量、时间表达和简短回答。
answer_note: Textbook reading answer is labelled suggested. Workbook answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 59 key; Practice A accepts pad or one. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 59 grammar key, including printed I/we alternatives. In grammar I.1e the key omits the article before spoon; the supplied answer retains a spoon to match the question and example pattern. No external sources were used.

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. Does the lady buy any chalk?
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。这位女士有没有买粉笔？

lines.speaker: Shop Assistant
lines.text: Do you want the large size or the small size?
lines.translation: 您要大号的还是小号的？

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: Do you have any writing paper?

lines.speaker: Shop Assistant
lines.text: I don't have any small pads. I only have large ones. Do you want a pad?
lines.translation: 我没有小的信笺簿，只有大的。您要一本吗？

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: And I want a large box of chalk, too.

lines.speaker: Shop Assistant
lines.text: I only have small boxes. Do you want one?
lines.translation: 我只有小盒的。您要一盒吗？

lesson.title: Before-reading question
lesson.instruction: Listen to the tape then answer this question. Does the lady buy any chalk? 听录音，然后回答问题。这位女士有没有买粉笔？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue. 根据对话回答问题。
lesson.context: The lady refuses the small box because she wants a large box and the shop assistant only has small boxes.

questions.prompt: Does the lady buy any chalk?

items.title: Do you want the large size or the small size?
items.text: 这句话是选择疑问句，逗号前的 size 读升调，后者读降调。

items.title: I only have large ones.
items.text: 句中的 ones 指 pads。

items.title: What else do you want?
items.text: 您还要什么吗？其中的 What else ...? 可以看作是表示疑问的一个短语，意思是：“还有什么吗？”

lesson.text:
参考译文
女 士：请给我拿几个信封。
售货员：您要大号的还是小号的？
女 士：请拿大号的。

女 士：你们有信纸吗？
售货员：有。

售货员：我没有小的信笺簿，只有大的。您要一本吗？
女 士：好，请拿一本。

女 士：我还要些胶水。
售货员：一瓶胶水。

女 士：我还要一大盒粉笔。
售货员：我只有小盒的。您要一盒吗？
女 士：不要了，谢谢。

售货员：就要这些吗？
女 士：就这些，谢谢。

售货员：您还要什么吗？
女 士：我要找的钱。
lesson.translation: Full Chinese reference translation of the lesson dialogue.

practice.title: A Dialogue
practice.instruction: Read this. Fill in the missing words. 读下面的对话，填空。
practice.translation: 读对话并填写缺少的单词。
practice.context: Complete each dialogue turn. Multiple blanks in one printed sentence are one answer field; answers are listed in blank order. The key accepts either pad or one in turn 5.

questions.prompt: You: Good morning. I want ______ envelopes, ______.
Shop Assistant: Do you ______ the large ______ or the ______ size?
You: The large ______, please. And I want ______ paper.
Shop Assistant: ______ you want a ______ pad or a small ______?
You: A large ______, please. And a ______ of chalk.
Shop Assistant: Is that ______?
You: Yes, ______ all, thank ______.

practice.title: B What's the time?
practice.instruction: Write the times under the clocks. Add in the afternoon, at night, etc. if necessary. 在横线上写出时钟上所显示的时间，必要时可加上 in the afternoon, at night 等表示下午、晚上的短语。
practice.translation: Write each time in words, adding the appropriate time expression where necessary.
practice.context: Printed cues: 16:00, 9:00, 23:00, 14:00, 8:00, 10:00. The first item is a source example and is not editable.

practice.title: C Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Match the words on the left with the words on the right. Then write the shopping list. 搭配左、右两栏中的词并写出一张购物清单。
practice.translation: Match the quantity or container phrases with the correct nouns, then write the complete shopping-list phrases.
practice.context: Left column: 1 a small bottle; 2 a jar; 3 two boxes; 4 a large pad; 5 three loaves; 6 four pounds. Right column: a writing paper; b bread; c potatoes; d honey; e glue; f chalk. Printed example: 1 e, a small bottle of glue.
